title: Record times for coverage thresholds and maximal spacings
summary: Let $X_1,X_2, \ldots $ be independent uniform random points in a bounded region $A \subset {\bf R}^d$ having a smooth boundary, $d \geq 1$. Let $B \subset A$ be compact. The _coverage threshold_ of $B$, $R_n$, is the smallest $r$ such that $B$ is covered by the balls of radius $r$ centred on $X_1,\ldots,X_n$. The _maximal spacing_ $\tilde{R}_n$ is the volume of the largest ball contained in $A \setminus \{X_1,\ldots,X_n\}$.
